# A deploy under an open tab: the UI review

What a reader sees after a new version of OneUptime is deployed while their tab is open, as the production components draw it, before and after the UI review. Taken at twice the pixel density in headless Chromium from a review harness that mounts the real pieces on real pages: the Home layout with its side menu (the `packages/E2E/HomeOverview` fixture), a dashboard with a Markdown text widget whose code chunk is answered 404 (the `packages/E2E/DashboardTimeRange` fixture), and a page under the Dashboard's product bar whose route chunk is answered 404. The new version is found by the real `NewVersion` check against a `build.json` the harness answers; nothing is mocked inside the components. The offline suite `packages/E2E/NewVersion` (`npm run test-new-version-ui`) takes the same states in its own small app at 1280 and 390 pixels, light and dark, German and Persian.

- `notice-before-1280-light.png`, `notice-after-1280-light.png`: the corner notice. Its title is one line now, "OneUptime has been updated", and its words say what happens next without an "it" that points nowhere: "The next page you open loads the new version."
- `notice-after-390-dark.png`: the notice on a phone, in the dark theme, between its 16px gutters.
- `notice-unsaved-after-fa-dark.png`: Reload with unsaved changes on the page asks first, in Persian, right to left. A double click on Reload no longer passes the question: its second click lands on Reload anyway and is ignored.
- `widget-needs-reload-before-1280-light.png`, `widget-needs-reload-after-1280-light.png`: a widget whose code will not download while something is unsaved on the dashboard. It was a bordered row at the top of the widget with the page's loudest button; it is now drawn as the widget draws its own states - an icon in a soft circle above one short line and a small plain button, in the middle of the widget. A two-row tile leaves the icon out, as its own note does.
- `widget-failed-before-1280-dark.png`, `widget-failed-after-1280-dark.png`: the same widget once its code could not be loaded even after the one reload, in the amber a widget that cannot be drawn shows.
- `page-updating-before-1280-light.png`, `page-updating-after-1280-light.png`: a page whose code is gone, under the product bar, as it reloads into the new version: "OneUptime was updated while you had it open. This page will open in the new version in a moment."
- `page-needs-reload-after-390-de.png`: the same page while something is unsaved, in German: "This page needs the new version to open." Titles that wrap now wrap into even lines.
- `page-updating-after-390-fa-dark.png`: the updating page in Persian, dark, on a phone.

Not in a picture: the notice sat at z-40 after the app in the document, so it drew over the AI chat panel and over a phone's full-width side panel. It sits at z-[25] now, over the page and its sticky bars and under every side panel, the AI chat, dialogs and menus; `NewVersion.spec.ts` measures it in a browser with the product's own layer classes.
